670S / 670GTS: Cortech Endurance Cascade Base Table with 42” Round Molded Top
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-670s-endurance-cascade-table-42-round-top
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/tables/endurance-cascade-base-table/
Spec sheets: 670S / 670GTS, Installation, Ballasting
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Cascade Base Table with 42” Round Molded Top – 670S / 670GTS
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Cascade 42" Round Top Table with Cascade Molded Base and Molded Top - Model 670S
Subtitle: Fully Molded 42” Round Table with a Flowing Cascade Base, Plain or Game Top, Rated for Outdoor Use
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 670S Endurance Cascade Table with Laminate Top / 670GTS Game Top Table
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Cascade Base Table brings biophilic design to dining rooms, dayrooms, and activity rooms. Its molded base follows the flow of water, and it is paired here with a matching 42” round molded top in a plain or game top.
The top and base are rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene, and the base attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws. The table can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes, or weighted with sandbags through an optional ballast door hidden under the top. It is rated for outdoor use.
Material: Top and base rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene
Base: Molded Cascade base that attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws
Top: 42” round molded top
Dimensions: 42”W×42”D×29”H
Weight: 38 lbs (top 22 lbs, base 16 lbs)
Ballast: Optional ballast door, hidden under the top, for adding weight with sandbags; secured with tamper-resistant screws
Game Top: Optional molded game top (670GTS)
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
670S – Plain Top: 42” round molded top, 38 lbs
670GTS – Game Top: 42” round molded game top, 38 lbs
Installation and Options
Assembly: The base attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws and washers (T40 bit); see Cortech instructions
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor through concealed pilot holes with the Sabre Mount System; drill holes at least 2” deep and use concrete anchors
Ballast: Remove the ballast door panel screws (T27 bit), add sandbags, and replace the door; Cortech says not to use loose sand
[H2] Applications
The Cascade Base Table suits dining and recreation areas where a table has to stand up to hard daily use while looking less institutional.
Typical applications include:
Dining rooms and dayrooms in correctional facilities and jails
Behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and activity rooms
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (65 characters): Cortech Endurance Cascade Base Table - 670S / 670GTS at Anchortex
Meta description (153 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance Cascade Base Table. A fully molded 42” round table with a flowing base, plain or game top, and floor mount or ballast options.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I shortened it and added the 670GTS game top.
Variant names: your variants say "Solid Top." The Cortech spec sheet says "Plain Top," the same as on the Norix table pages. Would you like them renamed, for example "670S - Plain Top"?
Weight: both variants are set to 255 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 38 lbs (top 22 lbs, base 16 lbs), so I used 38 lbs. The game top weighs the same as the plain top.
Model numbers: the Cortech spec sheet lists the 670 (plain top) and 670GT (game top), with the color code in between. I kept your 670S and 670GTS.
Subtitle: your current subtitle says "with Laminate Top," but this page sells the molded top. I left laminate out.
Laminate tops: your current page lists laminate tops (42” or 48” round, 42”×42” square) as options. Cortech sells these on a separate spec sheet, and they are not variants on this page, so I left them out. Cortech says laminate tops are not recommended for outdoor use.
Concealed floor mount: the Cortech web page mentions a "Fully Concealed Floor Mounting System" (patent pending). The spec sheet calls it the Sabre Mount System, so I used that name in the Installation section only.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says fully molded tables are rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Product images: the page has two images. The last image is the older Cortech color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like it replaced?
